Resolves #18615
Refs #18605

Pins the standalone declared-perspective boundary using the existing static-closure instrument and a minimal Workspace fixture. A fresh Node process constructs the real bound toolbar, switches from Operator to Review, and checks the document, provider state and pressed buttons while Transaction, History and TopologyLibrary remain unloaded. The process boundary prevents other unit files' imports from contaminating the result.

Evidence: L2 achieved and required — static module traversal plus real Neo instances in the unit runtime; no browser-paint claim. Residual: none for this leaf.
Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029.
Change class: zero-delta (test coverage only).

## Deltas from ticket
Adds a runtime-loading check beside static closure: an accidental dynamic import during selection can preserve the static graph while still loading the optional tier. The fixture is an ordinary Workspace subclass beside the existing dock-authoring pane fixture; no engine source changes.

## Test Evidence
Two deliberate mutations were run and reverted:
- Add a static Transaction import to the fixture: the new arm fails at the static forbidden-path assertion.
- Add an awaited dynamic Transaction import to its click handler: static closure stays clean, but the same arm fails because `transaction` becomes true after the switch.

The clean instrument passes 6/6. Measured fixture closure at this head: 84 modules / 1,627,747 raw source bytes; this is an observation, not a fixed budget or compressed-bundle measurement. The existing positive control still finds Transaction as a lazy target.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted in Engine; commit hooks and hosted baseline jobs cover their available checks.
